question: Which section of the Meru Tantra concludes with this colophon?
premises: The colophon identifies the source text as the Meru Tantra
The text is described as approved by Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla and composed by Śiva
The section is named and numbered
inference: This is the conclusion of the twenty-first exposition on the sun mantra in the Meru Tantra
plain_english: Thus ends the twenty-first exposition on the sun mantra in the Meru Tantra, approved by venerable Mahāmāyā and Mahākāla and composed by Śiva.
